Cookbook.discoverTitle: A simple and intuitive way to share and discover recipes
Cookbook.discoverIntro: Find inspiration, share your recipes and build your own cookbook.
Cookbook.cookbookIntro: Your recipes, your words. Keep them private, or share something delicious.
Cookbook.welcome: A home for your recipes. Private by default, ready to share when you are.
Cookbook.startRecipe: Start with a photo and a title. You can add the rest whenever you like.
Cookbook.trySearch: Try a different search or filter.
Cookbook.minimum: A photo and a title are all you need. Everything else is optional.
Cookbook.title: Recipe title
Cookbook.imageHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 20 MB. We resize your photo before uploading.
Cookbook.ingredientsHelp: Write ingredients your way, one per line. Quantities and catalogue matches are optional.
Cookbook.ingredientsExample:
200 g pasta
A handful of basil
Salt, to taste
Cookbook.optionalMatch: Optional: match with the ingredient catalogue
Cookbook.catalogueUnavailable: The catalogue is unavailable. You can still save this ingredient as written.
Cookbook.conversionHelp: Check the result before applying. Text is kept together rather than split into guessed steps.
Cookbook.privateHelp: Only you can see this recipe in your cookbook.
Cookbook.publicHelp: Anyone can see this recipe on your public page and in Discover.
Cookbook.saveHint: Only a photo and a title are required.
Cookbook.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again. Your input has been kept.
Cookbook.required: Add a title and a photo before saving.
Cookbook.deleteConfirm: Delete this recipe? This cannot be undone.
Cookbook.profileIntro: Make your public recipe page your own.
Cookbook.nicknameHelp: 2–40 characters: letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores.
Cookbook.publicProfileHelp: Your name, username, bio and profile photo are public. Only published recipes appear on your public page.
Cookbook.aboutTitle: A home for the recipes you love.
Cookbook.aboutIntro: Bonapp is your personal cookbook: capture a recipe with a photo and a title, add the details in your own words, and choose what to share. Ingredient ordering and delivery have ended.
Cookbook.retiredIntro: Bonapp is now a personal recipe app. Our shop, ingredient ordering and delivery are no longer available. Discover a recipe or create your own cookbook.

errors._INVALID_NICKNAME: Choose an available username using 2–40 letters, numbers, dots, hyphens or underscores. App page names are reserved.
errors._IDENTITY_ALREADY_USED: That email or username is already taken.
errors._INVALID_REGISTRATION: Enter your name, username, a valid email and a password of at least 8 characters.
errors._INVALID_PROFILE: Check your name and bio (up to 1,000 characters).
